disclaimer: Research memo for Constitutional Capitalism transition design. Not formal legal advice. Citations point to public statutes/rules; counsel must verify before any district action.
purpose: For every proposed magnet-hub pathway: Can it be done now? → who has authority? → what funding already exists? → what appropriation is required? → what federal funding can stack? → what law must change? → what would require constitutional action?
platform_advantage_sentence: Here is X. Here is the authority that already exists. Here is the money already available. Here is the gap. Here is the smallest legal change required. Here is the pilot. Here is how we measure it.

authoritative_anchors.relevance: Statewide K-12 reform package including career-ready pathway diploma option

authoritative_anchors.cite: Ark. Code § 6-16-1801 et seq. (High School Career-Ready Pathways to Diploma)
authoritative_anchors.relevance: Beginning with 9th-grade class of 2024-2025, students may earn a diploma through a career-ready pathway with modern CTE aligned to high-wage, high-growth jobs; diploma has same status as standard diploma

authoritative_anchors.cite: Division of Career and Technical Education (DCTE) under ADE / State Board of Education
authoritative_anchors.relevance: Approves CTE programs of study, adopts CTE rules, distributes federal/state CTE funds, instructor licensure/permits
Operational rules for secondary CTE programs and CTSO integration (FFA etc.)

authoritative_anchors.cite: Carl D. Perkins Career and Technical Education Act (federal) via state plan
authoritative_anchors.relevance: Primary federal CTE funding stack for approved Programs of Study

authoritative_anchors.cite: WIOA + Registered Apprenticeship (USDOL) / Arkansas Office of Skills Development
authoritative_anchors.relevance: Adult/youth apprenticeship and workforce funding stack attachable to hub employers

pathway_feasibility.title: Agriculture / food-system CTE magnet core (school-centered)
who_has_authority: Local school board / district (program offering, facilities use agreements)
DCTE / State Board of Education (CTE program of study approval)
State Board course/curriculum requirements for career-ready pathways (§ 6-16-1801)
funding_already_exists: State CTE support through DCTE (verify current allocations)
pathway_feasibility.appropriation_required: None for using existing CTE/career-ready pathway authorities; new facilities may need local/state capital appropriation or USDA Community Facilities
federal_funding_stack: USDA Community Facilities / local food programs (eligibility NEE_VERIFY)
pathway_feasibility.law_must_change: None identified for a standard DCTE-approved ag CTE / career-ready pathway configuration

WHY_THIS_CAN_START_NOW.explanation: LEARNS career-ready pathways + DCTE CTE approval create an existing-authority path for a school-centered agriculture magnet. Federal USDA facility/food stacks are program-dependent. No constitutional amendment required to begin.

pathway_feasibility.smallest_legal_change_if_blocked: None anticipated; if magnet branding or multi-district shared campus is blocked, use interlocal agreement / concurrent enrollment authorities before seeking new statute
pathway_feasibility.pilot: One district CTE/ag magnet cohort under career-ready pathway
pathway_feasibility.measure: CTE concentrators, credentials, apprenticeships, local placement — pre-register before launch

pathway_feasibility.title: Magnet-attached Registered Apprenticeship / skilled trades
who_has_authority: Arkansas Office of Skills Development / USDOL RA registration
Local WIOA board for training funds
funding_already_exists: Perkins V where secondary CTE aligns
pathway_feasibility.appropriation_required: None to use existing RA/WIOA frameworks; optional state incentive appropriations would expand scale

WHY_THIS_CAN_START_NOW.explanation: Apprenticeship attachment is primarily administrative under existing federal/state frameworks once a sponsor exists.

pathway_feasibility.smallest_legal_change_if_blocked: If youth apprenticeship age/liability rules constrain, seek targeted statutory clarification — not a constitutional path
pathway_feasibility.pilot: One trade cohort with named employer sponsor

pathway_feasibility.title: Rural allied / primary-care CTE pathway (not medical school substitute)
pathway_feasibility.appropriation_required: None for CTE certificates under existing approvals; new seats in medicine/dental/vet are separate capital/legislative packets
pathway_feasibility.law_must_change: None for standard allied CTE; expanding MD/DDS seats is a different pathway

WHY_THIS_CAN_START_NOW.explanation: Allied health CTE can start under existing education/clinical partnership authorities. Do not claim this closes HPSA physician gaps.

pathway_feasibility.smallest_legal_change_if_blocked: CHW scope/reimbursement statutes if community-health-worker pathway is chosen
pathway_feasibility.pilot: One allied/CHW/CNA cohort co-located with magnet hub geography
pathway_feasibility.measure: Certificates, clinical placement — not HPSA closure claims without design

pathway_feasibility.title: Community greenhouse / processing / food-hub facility components
who_has_authority: USDA Rural Development / AMS program officers
Eligible applicant entity (district, nonprofit, local government — verify per program)
pathway_feasibility.funding_already_exists: Programmatic authority exists federally; local award is not pre-secured
pathway_feasibility.appropriation_required: Possibly local match; federal award is competitive/formula-dependent
pathway_feasibility.law_must_change: None if eligible entity + approved use; entity form may need nonprofit/interlocal design

WHY_THIS_CAN_START_NOW.explanation: Facility/food stacks depend on USDA eligibility and awards — not on new Arkansas constitutional text.

pathway_feasibility.smallest_legal_change_if_blocked: Create eligible nonprofit/cooperative applicant if district cannot apply directly
pathway_feasibility.pilot: One facility component tied to measured food-system training outcomes
pathway_feasibility.measure: Training hours, producer partners, processing throughput (method NEE)

pathway_feasibility.title: Statewide structural reforms (campaign finance, constitutional redesign, etc.)
pathway_feasibility.law_must_change: Yes — legislation and/or constitutional amendment depending on proposal

WHY_THIS_CAN_START_NOW.explanation: Per local-proof principle: do not begin with statewide structural redesign. Prove Layer-1 locally first.

pathway_feasibility.smallest_legal_change_if_blocked: Keep Layer-4 research-bound until pilots produce measurable results

build_state_by_proving_locally.note: Recorded as operating principle under architecture freeze — does not mint CC-PRIN-* without gate
build_state_by_proving_locally.rule: The Arkansas system should not begin as one enormous statewide bill. Prove pieces locally before redesigning everything simultaneously.

holds: Overall % held at 43 until pilots + verified eligibility earn credit
Architecture freeze: no new CC-PRIN-* without gate
